_help.how_it_works: Edit any value and save. Values you leave alone are reused on every run. 'auto' lets the news decide.
_help.news_week: 'latest' or an ISO week such as '2026-W44' (Monday to Friday)
_help.story_focus: 'auto', a list of story ranks such as [1, 6], or a keyword such as 'Nvidia'
_help.exclude_story_ranks: story ranks to leave out, such as [7]
_help.explicit: true allows profanity, false keeps it clean
_help.extra_instructions: free text for a one-off steer, such as 'make the hook about oil'
_help.avoid_repeating_last_n_weeks: how many previous weeks' hooks to avoid repeating (0 turns this off)
_help.claude_model: Claude model alias that writes the song: 'opus', 'sonnet' or 'fable'
_help.elevenlabs_model: music model for the first take: 'music_v2_5' or 'music_v2' (retakes always use music_v2)
_help.max_takes: how many times the audio may be generated for one song when a take fails the listening check
_help.max_credits_per_song: most ElevenLabs credits one week's song may use, counting every take
